Game Overview

In Trallero Tung Tung Chicken, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the chaotic farmyard as Trallero or Tung Sahur, racing your friends to capture elusive chickens. Break crates by jumping, snag chickens, and dash to the coop. First to gather ten wins the farmyard frenzy. Can you outsmart your rival and rule the roost?
